summary:
S02a covers TV 40/41/42/45/46/47/48 (73 files, 29,524 lines) against VV 42/41/43/46/47/40 (63 files, 24,352 lines). Every shared file was checked by devlog, whitespace-blind diff, comment-stripped code diff and export comparison. A resolver also mapped each TV import onto VV and listed every missing file or name (Appendix A). Nothing was run in either app.

Main results:
(1) The folder map no longer works. VV's +1/+2 shift (D05) leaves no slot for TV's new 47 DrawingPlanes, 48 CrossSectionViews and 49 ElevationDepthFog. The recommendation is to renumber VV to TV's numbers first, in one atomic package (affects ~100 files).
(2) VV lacks the whole v2.86 draft system: DraftMaths, DrawingUsage, DevRowShell, DraftGuard, the RowAccordion guard, staged renames and Modal 1.1/1.2. VV's Dev rows still write live, so any other save can move every viewport drawn from a half-edited plan.
(3) Critical port hazard: TV editors pass the presentation config as the first argument to the data modules' Create and Delete calls. VV's data modules treat that argument as a drawings block and would write plan and elevation arrays into PresentationMode__SavedCameraScenes. TV's data-module convention must be ported first.
(4) VV is missing: the v2.87 storey (blocks LE ViewportIdentity, PlanDoors/Hide Swings and the title text); the v2.86 elevation auto-names; drawing planes plus the InteractiveOverlays registry (also needed for Show Compass); the Transitions 1.1.0 walk fix; and ProjectData 1.3-1.6 (payload guard, save steps, IsLoaded, base guard, report).
(5) VV is ahead or deliberately different in four areas: the floor plan and elevation mode controllers (TV is still on 1.1.0), sections filed by drawing type, the drawing-approach flag and the thumbnail bake.
(6) TV's 2.x menus dropped or never had four VV features: the styles/exclusion rows (D33), Ground Floor Plan (D11), bake-before-save (D20) and the thumbnail bake. Adam needs to decide whether VV keeps them.
(7) By code reading only, TV and VV write CrossSection__SceneData positionMm with opposite signs, so TD06 interchangeability is not met. TV's per-scene section restore listener is also dead, because TV never dispatches na-pm-scene-activated.
(8) Recommendation: rename VV ComposerPreset to RenderPreset. The interface is identical and the composer route stays inside the file.

There are 15 work packages and 10 decisions. VV paths are pre-renumber; translate them if WP-S02a-01 lands first.

findings.title: VV +1/+2 drawing-folder shift has no slot for TV 47/48/49
findings.detail: VV D05 shifted the new drawing folders (42 core, 43 plans, 44 annotations, 45 dimensions, 46 elevations, later 47 north) to keep legacy 40/41. TV has since added 47 DrawingPlanes, 48 CrossSectionViews and 49 ElevationDepthFog. TV 47 collides with VV 47 North, and TV 49 has no number below VV 50 ProjectedLinework. Under the current map every port rewrites paths, and the new folders cannot be placed consistently.
findings.recommendation: Renumber VV to TV's numbers in one atomic WP before any other port: 42->40, 43->42, 44->43, 45->44, 46->45, 47->46; move VV legacy 40 out (e.g. 39); VV 41 keeps 41 (different engine, same role). Then TV 47/48/49 land unchanged. Verify with Na__Verify__ModuleGraph__ and Na__Verify__Exports__.
findings.evidence: VV PLAN D05 (ValeVision__PLAN__TrueVisionPort__LayoutEditor__.md:53); TV realign plan s.4.1 lines 304-321. VV references: 42__ 51 files/124, 43__ 11/22, 44__ 7/14, 45__ 9/33, 46__ 11/23, 47__ 6/13, 40 legacy 4/6.

findings.title: VV legacy 40__System__2dElevationsView occupies slot 40 and still feeds the composer
findings.detail: VV-only folder (8 files, 2,407 lines) is a live user tool: Tools > Elevation View (index.html:518-535, init :2149). Its export overrides run ahead of the drawing preset's (:1874). Its Na__RenderEffect__2dProfileLines__ is the ortho profile pass VV's ComposerPreset is built on (42/...ComposerPreset__.js:93). D06 keeps it 'untouched for now'. TV has no counterpart. It blocks slot 40 under the renumber.
findings.recommendation: Keep the tool for now and move the folder to 39__System__2dElevationsView inside the renumber WP. Alternatively, retire the menu item and move Na__RenderEffect__2dProfileLines__ into DrawingViewCore. Adam decides.

findings.title: drift_all vv_ver is the PORT NOTE source version; DraftMode plan is unrelated to DraftGuard
findings.detail: drift_all.tsv vv_ver holds VV's '- Source version:' line, i.e. the TV version it was ported FROM, not VV's current version. Examples: 43 DevMenu Editor reads 1.0.0 but is 1.2.0; 43 ModeController reads 1.1.0 but is 1.2.2. TrueVision__PLAN__DraftMode__.md covers the LE Draft Mode (K key, 51/26__System__DraftMode). It has nothing on DrawView DraftGuard/DraftMaths, which are specified in TrueVision__PLAN__DrawingMenus__.md s.3 and TV devlog v2.86.0.
findings.recommendation: Planner: take VV versions from DEVELOPMENT LOG tops (report table c). Brief DraftGuard work from the DrawingMenus plan and devlog v2.86.0 (line 7788), not the DraftMode plan.
findings.evidence: VVM/43/Na__FloorPlan__DevMenu__Editor__.js:43 (Source version 1.0.0) vs :59 (Version 1.2.0); VVM/43/...ModeController__.js:49 vs :63.

findings.title: TV editors pass the presentation config where VV data modules expect a drawings block
findings.detail: TV editors call Na__FpData__CreatePlan(config,..)/DeletePlan(config,..) and Na__ElevData__CreateElevation(config,..)/DeleteElevation(config,..) with the PresentationMode block; TV's data modules ignore arg 1 for records. VV's treat arg 1 as an optional drawings block (Na__FpData__Block / Na__ElevData__Block). EnsureArray would then create LayoutEditor__DrawingsData__FloorPlans/__Elevations inside PresentationMode__SavedCameraScenes, corrupting the next save silently once TV's editors run against VV's data modules.
findings.recommendation: Port TV's data-module convention first: records always via Na__DrawData__Get*Array, arg 1 = sceneConfig (ignored for records). All 18 current VV external callers pass null or nothing, so the switch is safe. Add a Node check that Create/Delete with a presentation object leaves that object untouched.
findings.evidence: TVM/42/Na__FloorPlan__DevMenu__Editor__.js:957,1064; TVM/45/Na__Elevation__DevMenu__Editor__.js:1075,1228; VVM/43/Na__FloorPlan__ProjectJson__Data__.js:160; VVM/46/Na__Elevation__ProjectJson__Data__.js:181.

findings.title: Na__DrawView__ProjectData__ is four TV versions behind (payload guard, save steps, IsLoaded, report)
findings.detail: TV 1.6.0 vs VV 1.2.0. VV lacks: 1.3.0 RegisterPayloadGuard (an unfinished draft goes out as last Updated in ANY save); 1.4.0 RegisterSaveStep (before/payload/after, used by Sheet Images); 1.5.0 IsLoaded (LE late-start draft restore); 1.6.0 SavedIso stamp and base guard; Save(showToast, report, registerKeys). VV-only Get/SetLayoutModeEnabled is used by VV's lazy loader and stays. TV's legacy-migration region is TV-only history.
findings.recommendation: Add RegisterPayloadGuard, RegisterSaveStep, IsLoaded, SAVED_ISO_KEY stamping and report/registerKeys to VV Save. Fill report.local from R2SaveProjectJson's {r2Success, localSuccess} and suppress its own toast when a report is given. Defer GetBase/WhenBaseKnown/CheckBase to the transport WP.
findings.evidence: TVM/40/Na__DrawView__ProjectData__.js:710 (Save), :862 (RegisterPayloadGuard), :873 (RegisterSaveStep); VVM/42/...ProjectData__.js:380,389; VVM/03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__R2SaveProjectJson__.js:184-219.
findings.vv_adaptation: Keep Flask GET /api/projects/{code} merge + R2SaveProjectJson (R2 first, Flask mirror); no migration region; keep LayoutModeEnabled.

findings.title: v2.146 drawings save guard needs Flask routes VV does not have
findings.detail: After each load, TV 1.6.0 learns a base: the local server's sha1 fingerprint of the drawings block (or the SavedIso stamp on the web). Save refuses BEFORE writing R2 when the disk has moved on. The local write carries the base, and the server answers 409 and backs up every overwritten copy. VV's Flask WCP/server.py has none of these routes. LE AutoSave 1.5.0 imports GetBase/WhenBaseKnown/SAVED_ISO_KEY.
findings.recommendation: In WCP/server.py, add GET /api/projects/<code>/drawings-fingerprint, a base header on the project POST (409 on mismatch) and backups before overwrite. Add GetBase/WhenBaseKnown/CheckBase to VV ProjectData. The worker needs no change (TV does not judge R2 either). Adapt Na__Test__ProjectDataSaveGuard__.test.py to server.py.
findings.evidence: TV devlog v2.146.0 lines 1901-2005; TVM/40/...ProjectData__.js:490-551 (GetBase, LearnBase, CheckBase); LE AutoSave imports (le_deps.txt line 50).
findings.vv_adaptation: Routes live in Whitecardopedia's server.py (not ProjectVision); VV project folders resolve via get_project_path.

findings.title: DraftMaths and DrawingUsage (pure helpers of the draft system) missing
findings.detail: Na__DrawView__DraftMaths__ (246 lines) handles snapshot, changed keys (view keys ignored), restore-in-place and substitute-in-payload. Na__DrawView__DrawingUsage__ (156) counts the sheet viewports drawn from a drawing, by the sheet model's rule. Both import nothing and run under Node. VV sheets already carry every key DrawingUsage reads (Sheet__Name, Sheet__Fields__DrawingNumber, Sheet__Viewports, Viewport__Kind/DrawingId/SceneId).
findings.recommendation: Port both verbatim (header and console prefix only) into the drawing core. Port Na__Test__DrawingDrafts__.test.mjs with VV folder paths and a VV fixture (D37 Doous or the test's builtFixture).

findings.detail: 486 lines; v2.86. Provides the panel head with its +, header swatch and chips, Update/Revert actions, danger zone, Advanced fold, the Update/Delete dialogs and WhereSaved(report). Imports 21 Modal Confirm, ProjectData.GetSheetsArray and DrawingUsage, and uses existing na-pm-dev__ classes (all present in VV). Imported by both editors, both row builders, the 48 placeholder and TV 49's fog row.

findings.title: Na__DrawView__DraftGuard__ missing - VV Dev rows still write drawings live
findings.detail: 491 lines; v2.86. One draft across both panels: owners per type, ConfirmLeave, Revert (same object, arrays refilled), SaveActive/SaveBlock, plus a payload guard registered at load. Without it, VV's rows change the live record on every slider. The drawings block is saved whole by whoever saves next (Save Sheets, north, rename), so a brushed slider moves every sheet viewport of that drawing.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim (paths) after ProjectData RegisterPayloadGuard/report and RowAccordion SetChangeGuard/OnOpenChanged. Wire the owners through the rebuilt editors.

findings.detail: TV (20-Sep, v2.86) adds SetChangeGuard, OnOpenChanged and RequestOpenId (a header click ASKS before the slot moves), plus header lead/trail elements, and Wrap returns name. SetOpenId/IsOpen/GetOpenId/CloseIfOpen are unchanged, so VV's current callers keep working. TV's PORT NOTE says change (2) 'goes back with the Floor Plans and Elevations menu rebuild'.

findings.title: RenameDrawing lacks StageFloorPlan/StageElevation (rename inside a draft)
findings.detail: TV 1.1.0 (20-Sep) adds StageHolders/StageFloorPlan/StageElevation: the card name, section-binding key and sheet fingerprints are staged in memory with an undo, so a name rides in the row draft and lands with one Update. VV restamps through its lazy LE loader (Na__LeLoad__PrepareRestamp/RestampForScene); TV imports Viewport3d dynamically.

findings.title: Transitions 1.1.0: sheet pictures still kick a walking user into Orbit in VV
findings.detail: TV 1.1.0 (21-Sep, v2.112) adds ReturnToOrbit and leaves Walk/Fly only when SuspendThreeD({returnToOrbit:true}) is asked; the LE asks, the snapshot renderer does not. VV's SuspendThreeD() always converts, and VV's snapshot renderer calls it for every picture. TV's original toolbar-repaint fault is absent in VV: SetOrbitMode runs HandleOrbitClick, a real exit.

findings.title: DrawView dev stylesheet lacks the Drawing Panel Shell region and loads in the wrong cascade slot
findings.detail: TV adds the .na-draw-dev__* region (panel head, swatch, chips, captions, actions grid, green commit button, danger zone, disabled-button rule) for the rebuilt panels. TV imports this sheet LAST in the drawing group of its CSS index; VV imports it FIRST, so its overrides (e.g. .na-pm-dev__btn:disabled) would lose to later sheets.

findings.title: Rename VV Na__DrawView__ComposerPreset__ to Na__DrawView__RenderPreset__ (DIV-1 seam)
findings.detail: Both apps expose the same eight functions (ApplyStyles, Enter, Exit, GetCamera, GetExportOverrides, Initialize, IsActive, RenderFrame) under different module and export prefixes. TV's design says 'the seam is the eight function names'. Every TV caller (LE SnapshotRenderer, the 49 fog layer) therefore needs a rename to port. VV's composer route (D12) can live behind TV's name unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Rename the VV file and exports to Na__DrawView__RenderPreset__*, keep the composer implementation, and write a PORT NOTE: 'TV interface, composer route (DIV-1, D12)'. Update the importers: LoadingSequence:425, 43/46 ModeControllers, 51/25 SnapshotRenderer:132, index.html:1412,1874,2211.
findings.evidence: exports.py: TV RenderPreset and VV ComposerPreset share 8 suffixes; TVM/40/Na__DrawView__RenderPreset__.js DESCRIPTION; VV importer lines listed.

findings.title: ProfileLines overlay route stays TV-only (DIV-1)
findings.detail: TV's Na__DrawView__ProfileLines__ (738 lines) draws a Sobel overlay quad over a flat render. It is used by TV's render loop, thumbnail renderer, tiled exporter, RenderPreset and the LE SnapshotRenderer (SetEdgeWidth, InvalidateSceneCache). VV renders drawings through its composer, using the legacy 2dProfileLines pre-pass and an Enter edgeWidthPx override (ComposerPreset 1.3.0).
findings.recommendation: Do not port. Ports of TV LE code that call Na__DrawProfile__SetEdgeWidth/InvalidateSceneCache must map them to VV's Enter({edgeWidthPx}) and a documented no-op.
findings.evidence: TV realign plan s.2.2 DIV-1 lines 83-99; TVM/01/...LoadingSequence.js:1171-1177; VV ComposerPreset 1.3.0 dev log.

findings.title: Drawing view edge width: TV 0.55 vs VV 1.0
findings.detail: TV ConfigState 1.0.1 (13-Sep) and AppConfig set ProfileEdgeWidth 0.55, the width TV's live overlay views draw at, so a LE bake does not leave them thicker. VV's composer writes the width to the pass uniform every frame, so VV does not have that fault, and 1.0 is VV's own live width.
findings.recommendation: Keep VV's 1.0 and record it as a DIV-1 divergence in both PORT NOTEs.

findings.title: MaterialPreset dual style-key read and MaxEngine gate
findings.detail: TV reads both Styles__GlassOpaque and glassOpaque, and drops VV's MaxEngine gate on the whitecard swap (TV has one pipeline). VV's ledger records the dual read as a deliberate non-port: VV callers always pass mapped flags via GetStyles.

findings.title: Na__DrawView__ThumbnailBake__ (VV-only) must survive the menu rebuild
findings.detail: VV 1.0.1 (433 lines) queues added or seeded drawings, opens each, records framing, captures and uploads, then saves once; it also backs 'Bake Missing Thumbnails'. TV 2.x only takes the picture on Update while the drawing is on screen, so new TV cards still show broken images. VV's Queue calls the editor's own Save (Na__FpDev__Save / Na__ElevDev__Save), which disappears in TV's 2.x editors.

findings.title: Section engines and SectionAdapter stay different by design (DIV-2/TD06)
findings.detail: TV 41 SectionCutEngine (7 files) and VV 41 CrossSectionView (7 files, the live user tool) are different engines in the same role. Na__DrawView__SectionAdapter__ exposes the same 13 exports in both apps. Scene-data APIs differ: TV has Load/RemoveForScene and a provider registration; VV has the capture toggle. The LE SnapshotRenderer calls each engine's serialize pair directly, a permanent seam.
findings.recommendation: Keep both. Ported TV code that calls 41/Na__SectionCut__* (editors: SetPlaneHeightMm, SetPlaneDistanceMm) must call the matching Na__DrawView__SectionAdapter__* in VV.
findings.evidence: exports.py: adapters share 13 names; TVM/42/...Editor__.js:211,421; TVM/45/...Editor__.js:130,440.

findings.title: CrossSection__SceneData positionMm sign is opposite in the two apps (TD06 not met)
findings.detail: VV writes positionMm = -plane.constant and restores the plane through normal*positionMm (constant = -positionMm). TV writes +plane.constant and restores constant = +positionMm. The same {normalXyz, positionMm} therefore builds planes mirrored through the world origin: a TV plan cut at 1200 would restore in VV at y = -1200. Each app round-trips its own data. Code reading only, not executed.
findings.recommendation: No VV change. Fix TV to VV's convention (TD06 says VV's schema wins, and TV's own mapping table says -constant), and migrate TV's saved bindings. Add a cross-app fixture test once fixed. Adam decides.
findings.evidence: VVM/41/Na__CrossSectionView__SystemLogic.js:1502,1540-1542,567; TVM/41/Na__SectionCut__Serialize__.js:194,261; TV realign plan s.3.2 mapping table.

findings.title: TV TD06 wiring gaps: dead scene-activated listener, no approach flag
findings.detail: TV Na__SectionCut__SceneData__ restores on 'na-pm-scene-activated', which no TV module dispatches: TV's carousel raises 'na-presentation-mode-scene-activated'. TV's Framing modules never set PresentationMode__Scene__IsDrawingApproach, although TV SceneData checks it. VV dispatches the event and sets the flag. VV is correct; these are TV back-port items.
findings.recommendation: Record both in the back-port memo for TV. No VV change.

findings.title: Floor plan and elevation mode controllers: VV is ahead, keep VV

findings.detail: TV 1.1.0 (v2.82) adds drawing planes; 2.0.0 (v2.86) adds folding draft rows, the green confirmed Update (framing + thumbnail + one save), Revert, the leave prompt, + in the head, Delete below a rule, no Save-all, and clients-measure saving at once. findings.detail: TV 2.0.0 builds rows from DevRowShell (Button, Caption, BuildCommitActions) and mounts StoreyRow under the name. It does NOT import StyleRows. VV 1.2.0 builds the Styles row and the Exclusions field through StyleRows (D33).

findings.title: VV-only drawing-menu features absent from TV's 2.x menus
findings.detail: TV 2.x has no Styles/Exclusions rows (D33). StyleRows is imported by nothing in TV, and nothing calls Set*Style/SetExcludeTokens, although records keep the keys. It also lacks Ground Floor Plan (D11), the bake-before-save of projected linework (D20; the editors no longer call Na__PlStore__BakeBeforeSave and no devlog says why) and the thumbnail bake on add/seed. VV has all four.
findings.recommendation: Keep all four as VV seams inside TV's layout: Styles/Exclusions in the Advanced fold, Ground Floor beside +, bake on Update and add. Raise each as a TV back-port so the menus converge. Adam decides.

findings.detail: TV config adds FloorPlanViews__StoreyLevels__Config and six storey labels. VV config carries Ground Floor, Style, Exclusions and BakeThumbnails labels. The TV CSS adds the storey-note region; VV's CSS has the style-toggle region (D33).
